feeds.title: Retro To Go » Interior Design
feeds.description: Your daily guide to all things hip, retro and vintage, from design and interiors through to fashion and style plus everything in between. The site was set up around 2006 very much as a hobby and my personal blog, with David writing about things the has seen and loved, on the high street, online or indeed anywhere. Things haven't changed much since.

feeds.title: Mid-Century Home
feeds.description: Midcentury home helps you discover Mid-century modern architecture, homes and design. Follow the latest works from the biggest names in this design movement. Inspired by the Modernist and mid-century styles, Mid-Century Home brings you the best homes, architectures, interiors and more!

feeds.title: MidinMod Blog
feeds.description: Discussing Mid-Century Modern Design Ideas & Tips for Apartments Living, Loft Life, & Home Owners. Also, view the latest Mid Mod Sofas, Dining, etc. With over 25 years of experience in handling, selling, and distributing modern Texas furniture, MidinMod's mission is to give customers stylish and affordable furniture and dining sets. We have cut out the middle man by working directly with the manufacturers, and as a result, have passed those savings on to you in the form of high-quality and affordable furniture.

feeds.title: Essential Home Blog
feeds.description: This section of the blog, Luxury Furniture, is dedicated to all the design lovers that live by interior design trends and look forward to getting inspired by high-quality pieces and top designers. Essential Home displays the collection that expresses the finest combination of retro design and contemporary details of mid-century modern lines that are inspired by the most important historical references from the 30s to the 60s.

feeds.title: Wowhaus » Midcentury
feeds.description: WowHaus seeks out architecturally interesting properties for sale in both the UK and worldwide. Check out the mid-century houses and properties, interiors and more!

feeds.title: Atomic Ranch » Interior Design
feeds.description: Explore inspirational renovations, collectables & furnishings, plus get project tips, décor ideas & advice on retaining design elements to maintain or revive your home's atomic-age appeal. Atomic Ranch is your destination for MCM design, architecture and history, plus all the build, renovation, preservation, décor and lifestyle coaching you need to make life in this century optimally groovy.

feeds.title: Destination Eichler Blog
feeds.description: Destination Eichler started as a design blog for homeowners Karen Nepacena and John Shum to chronicle their journey renovating a mid-century modern Eichler home in Northern California. Their home renovation projects and blog gained national attention and soon the couple began taking on clients who were attracted to their modern design aesthetic and focus on mid-century modern architecture.

feeds.title: Mid Century Modern Hudson Valley Blog
feeds.description: Ellen Hilburg has been a highly successful realtor in the Hudson Valley for more than thirty years. The Mid-Century American style became a passion for her and she was an aficionado well before the current outbreak of 'Mid-Century Fever.' Ellen has shown and sold a number of period homes that managed to survive the decades and emerge in triumph to new popularity! Explore the blog for mid-century Hudson Valley homes and properties on sale, rent, trends and more!

feeds.title: Make It Mid Century Blog
feeds.description: At Make it Mid Century, we rescue mid-century homeowners from bland chain store improvements by offering vintage-inspired materials and kits. I'm Susan Halla, the founder and a mid-century enthusiast passionate about helping fellow mid-century fanatics like yourself avoid the boring and pursue home improvement in a truly inspired way for your interior and exterior doors, shutters, laminate, and more!

feeds.title: Mid Century Modern Design Finds
feeds.description: We are boutique resellers of authentic 20th-century design works to collectors, interior designers, and design enthusiasts around the world. Explore our blog to know more about our collections, items on sale and more!

feeds.title: Mid-Century Millennial
feeds.description: Vintage-inspired and thrift-forward DIY and home design, craft, renovation and lifestyle blog by Megan Housekeeper, the Mid-century Millennial. Megan is a vintage-loving content creator, writer, and marketing professional. Mid-century Millennial has become a bright spot on the internet for vintage-lovers of all ages.

feeds.title: Inspiration Design Books Blog » Mid-Century
feeds.description: Inspiration Design Books wants to inspire the world, to create the future. Always searching for the next and best innovations in the design culture, so you can always be one step ahead. Explore the designs inspired by mid-century period, tips, interior design ideas and more!

feeds.title: Tryst Craft Blog
feeds.description: Explore mid-Century Modern Furniture, Design and Architecture, interior designing tips, trends and more! Trystcraft is a vintage design and furnishing team. We've combined our love for restoring mid-century modern homes with our passion for great vintage design.

feeds.title: Retro Renovation Blog
feeds.description: Retro Renovation is your regular dose of mid-century and vintage renovation and decorating resources, design inspiration, fun finds and an archive of stories from an enthusiastic community of people all interested in cherishing their mid-century and older homes. Our focus here, first and foremost, is to help you find the products and sources you need to help remodel, renovate and decorate your house in authentic mid century style.

feeds.title: Dezeen » Mid Century Modern Design
feeds.description: Stories about mid-century modern architecture, furniture and interiors, created as part of the 20th-century design movement or in homage to it. Dezeen is the world's most popular and influential architecture, interiors and design magazine, with over three million monthly readers and six million social media followers.
